_note: 30-item quiz feeding the ENM Triangle. Each question is answered on a 1-5 Likert scale (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree). `weights` gives each axis a 0-1 loading (most questions load on one axis; a few load on two or three). `reverse: true` means agreement should REDUCE the loaded axis/axes, not raise them — app.js should score those using (6 - response) instead of response. See the spec's Scoring section for the exact formula.
